reasons.plausibility: It leverages established magnetocrystalline anisotropy from Pt-based L10 phases but depends on achieving stable L10 ordering in a quaternary high-entropy alloy, which remains somewhat uncertain.
reasons.testability: It outlines a clear experimental comparison with a well-defined control and explicit success/failure conditions, making it straightforward to test.
reasons.usefulness: It proposes a concrete route to enhance coercivity in FeCoNi-based alloys through an L10-ordered Pt addition, directly addressing the research question.
